name: @veda-hq/pariksha
description: Repository checks: doc drift, rule enforcement, test-quality ratchets. Checks: authority-citations, boundary, coverage-by-type, coverage-exemptions, doc-budgets, env-gate-switches, export-deletions, required-settings. Also markdownlint rules for Markdown that renders mangled: @veda-hq/pariksha/markdownlint.

scripts.smoke: node dist/cli.js --version && node dist/cli.js boundary --root ../.. && node dist/cli.js required-settings --require .veda/required-settings.json --root ../.. &&node --input-type=module -e "import { createRequire } from 'node:module'; import { pathToFileURL } from 'node:url'; const id = '@veda-hq/pariksha/markdownlint'; const req = createRequire(process.cwd() + '/'); const required = req(id); const imported = (await import(pathToFileURL(req.resolve(id, { paths: [process.cwd()] })).href)).default; if (!Array.isArray(required) || required !== imported || required.length !== 12) throw new Error(id + ' does not load as markdownlint-cli2 loads it');"
scripts.check: pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build && pnpm smoke
